title: Open a page and read it
scenario: BrowserSession opens the local fixture home page and takes a snapshot.
expected: Snapshot title is 'Bench Home', its heading text is present, the three nav links are listed by name, and the snapshot is marked untrusted.

title: Click a link by name and verify the new page
scenario: Click the link named 'Product details' on the home page.
expected: After the click the page URL ends in /product-details.html and the new heading is in the snapshot (state checked, not just the click call).

title: Similar link names cannot be confused
scenario: The page has 'Products' and 'Product details'. A click on the 'Products' id that names 'Product details' (or a prefix 'Product').
expected: Both clicks raise BrowserError and the page is still the home page.

title: Stale element id after the page changed
scenario: Snapshot, then the page swaps the 'Archive' button for a 'Delete all' button at the same id; the old id is clicked expecting 'Archive'.
expected: The click is refused ('element changed') and the status text still says 'nothing deleted'.

title: Content that appears after a delay
scenario: Search results are inserted by script 1.5 s after load.
expected: The first snapshot does not contain the answer or the 'Show more' button; a snapshot after 2.2 s contains 'the late answer is 42', and clicking the late button changes the page to 'More loaded'.

title: Slow page beyond the timeout
scenario: Session timeout 1.5 s; the server answers after 4 s.
expected: open() raises BrowserError within 3.5 s, and the same session then opens another page normally.

title: Slow page within the timeout
scenario: Session timeout 5 s; the server answers after 1.2 s.
expected: The page loads and its text 'Slow page finally loaded' is in the snapshot.

title: Redirect chain on an allowed host
scenario: open() on a URL that redirects three times before /products.html.
expected: The snapshot URL ends in /products.html and shows 'Our products'.

title: Redirect to the cloud metadata address
scenario: The fixture answers 302 to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/.
expected: open() raises BrowserError, the page URL never contains 169.254.169.254, and the host is in session.blocked.

title: Redirect to a private LAN address
scenario: The fixture answers 302 to http://10.0.0.5/admin.
expected: open() raises BrowserError, the page is not there, 10.0.0.5 is in session.blocked.

title: Redirect to a loopback name not on the allow list
scenario: Only 127.0.0.1 is allowed; the fixture redirects to http://localhost:<same port>/about.html (a live service).
expected: open() raises BrowserError and 'localhost' is in session.blocked (allowing one host does not allow the others).

title: Script navigation to the metadata address
scenario: A page sets location.href to http://169.254.169.254/... 100 ms after load.
expected: After 1.5 s the page URL does not contain 169.254.169.254 and the host is in session.blocked.

title: Meta refresh to a router address
scenario: A page's meta refresh points at http://192.168.1.1/admin.
expected: The page never lands on 192.168.1.1 and the host is in session.blocked.

title: Iframe and fetch() to internal addresses
scenario: One page embeds an iframe to 169.254.169.254; another page's script fetches http://192.168.1.1/router-config.
expected: Both hosts are in session.blocked and the page reports 'fetch blocked' (never 'LEAKED').

title: HTTP error pages are reported
scenario: Pages answering 404, 500 and 503 with a friendly 'Welcome back' body, then a normal page.
expected: open() returns the real status for each (404, 500, 503) with ok=False, and status 200 with ok=True for the normal page, so an error page cannot be mistaken for success.

title: Connection refused
scenario: open() on a 127.0.0.1 port with no listener.
expected: BrowserError 'navigation failed...' and the same session opens the next page normally.

title: Popups and new tabs are closed
scenario: Click a button that calls window.open and a target=_blank link.
expected: After each click only one page exists in the context and the working page is unchanged.

title: Downloads are never saved
scenario: Click a link served as Content-Disposition: attachment.
expected: No file named bench-report* exists in the throwaway profile or in ~/Downloads.

title: Hidden injected text is not shown to the model
scenario: A page hides 'ignore previous instructions' text nine ways (display:none, visibility, opacity 0, off-screen, font-size 0, transparent colour, hidden attribute, 1px clip, zero-height overflow). It also has an off-page button named INJECT-OFFSCREEN-BUTTON.
expected: No INJECT-* marker is in the snapshot text or element names; both visible paragraphs and 'Visible button' are.

title: Password fields are never typed into
scenario: Type into the field named 'Password'.
expected: The element is marked secret, typing raises BrowserError and the field stays empty.

title: Secret-looking text is never typed
scenario: Type a GitHub token, an AWS secret assignment and a private-key header into a normal name field.
expected: All three are refused and the field stays empty.

title: Form submit verified on the server
scenario: Fill name and email by element name, select topic 'billing', press Enter.
expected: The fixture server receives name=Ravi, email=ravi@example.com, topic=billing and no password; the page then says 'Thanks Ravi'.

title: Disabled control
scenario: Click a disabled button (timeout 1.5 s).
expected: The snapshot marks it disabled, the click fails in under 4 s, and its handler never ran.

title: Action budget
scenario: max_actions=3: three opens, then a fourth open and a key press.
expected: Both are refused with 'action budget used up' and the page stays on the third page.

title: Non-web schemes and embedded credentials
scenario: open() on file:, javascript:, data:, ftp:, chrome: URLs and http://user:pass@127.0.0.1/.
expected: All six raise BrowserError; the page never shows a file:, data: or chrome: URL.

title: Loopback needs an explicit allow list
scenario: A session with no allow list opens the local fixture site.
expected: BrowserError and 127.0.0.1 in session.blocked.

title: Only safe keys can be pressed
scenario: press() with Control+A, Alt+F4, Meta, Control+W, F12, then Tab.
expected: The five are refused; Tab works.

title: Long page is cut and says so
scenario: A page with 400 long paragraphs.
expected: Snapshot text is at most MAX_TEXT (8000) characters and truncated=True.

title: Secrets on a page are scrubbed
scenario: A page shows a GitHub token and a link carrying ?session=SESSIONSECRET123.
expected: Neither the token nor the session value appears anywhere in the snapshot.

title: Throwaway profile: nothing carries over
scenario: Session 1 gets a cookie; session 2 opens the cookie echo page.
expected: Session 1 sees benchsid=abc123, session 2 sees 'no cookie'; session 1's profile folder is deleted and its guard proxy port refuses connections.

title: No permissions granted
scenario: A page asks for geolocation and reads the notification permission.
expected: Geolocation is not granted and Notification.permission is not 'granted'.

title: Browser speed on local pages
scenario: Start a session, then open+snapshot five local pages.
expected: Session start < 10 s and the slowest open+snapshot < 2 s (local fixture, headless Chrome, this server).

title: A click that changes nothing is not reported as done
scenario: Through controller_for with the real kernel policy: click a button whose handler throws, retry it, then click a working one.
expected: First click -> 'mismatch'; the identical retry raises RepeatError; the working click -> 'verified' by the page text.

title: Clicking needs the owner's approval
scenario: Through controller_for and the real policy: click without an approval id.
expected: Result 'refused' at YELLOW_APPROVAL and the page state is unchanged.

title: Egress removed after reading a web page
scenario: observe() a page with injected text, then ask for a message send in the same session.
expected: The controller marks the session untrusted and the real policy answers DENY for the send.

title: CAPTCHA box is not ticked by the DOM browser
scenario: A 'verify you are human' page; the agent tries to click the checkbox through the controller without approval.
expected: Refused (approval needed) and the box stays unchecked.

title: Owner profile lookup by alias
scenario: browserext.resolve on a synthetic Chrome Local State: 'default', 'work', 'venkat.work', 'Profile 2', ''.
expected: default and '' -> Default, work and venkat.work -> Profile 1, 'Profile 2' -> Profile 2.

title: Ambiguous profile is asked about, not guessed
scenario: Alias 'venkat' is the Google given name on two profiles (Default and Profile 1); 'family' is one profile's exact name.
expected: resolve('venkat') raises 'ambiguous' naming Default and Profile 1; run() returns needs=clarification and starts no browser session; resolve('family') -> Profile 2 (an exact alias is not ambiguous).

title: Unknown profile
scenario: Alias 'zzqx' matches nothing.
expected: run() returns ok=False with 'no Chrome profile matches' and lists the known profiles.

title: Extension missing in that profile
scenario: op=read in the 'work' profile with no Playwright extension folder.
expected: run() returns needs=extension naming the extension id and the profile, and starts no connection.

title: Extension bridge does not connect
scenario: The MCP server starts but the extension never completes the handshake.
expected: run() returns ok=False with the 'is the Playwright extension allowed to connect?' hint, the server process is closed, no tool is called, and no work folder is left.

title: Only allowed MCP tools reach the owner's browser
scenario: Session.call with browser_run_code, browser_network_requests, browser_file_upload and a cookie-reading browser_evaluate.
expected: All four raise BrowserError before reaching the server; only the fixed video-state script passes; the server is started without --caps.

title: Sign-in page: never types a password
scenario: act(type) into 'Enter your password' on an accounts.google.com sign-in snapshot.
expected: BrowserError asking the owner to sign in, no browser_type call, and read() reports auth_required=True.

title: CAPTCHA in the owner's browser pauses for the owner
scenario: A reCAPTCHA 'I'm not a robot' page in the owner's profile: read it, then act(click) on the checkbox.
expected: read() reports challenge_required=True and the click raises BrowserError without any browser_click call.

title: Element named twice is not guessed
scenario: find_ref on a snapshot with two 'Delete' buttons, a 'Delete account' link and 'Save'.
expected: 'Delete' -> error naming both; 'Save' -> e12; 'delete acc' -> e11.

title: First real video from a results page
scenario: watch_links on a YouTube-like snapshot with an ad, a menu link, a playlist, a duplicate and a quoted title.
expected: Exactly [REALVIDEO01, SECONDVID01] in that order.

title: Owner's logged-in profile: open and confirm the account
scenario: Open a site in the owner's default Chrome profile through the extension and check the signed-in account on myaccount.google.com.
expected: The page opens in that profile and whoami's account fingerprint matches the registry's.

title: Owner's profile: play a video and verify playback
scenario: 'play lofi on youtube' in the owner's profile.
expected: The chosen video's id is in the tab and its position moves; if autoplay is blocked the owner is told to press play.
